definitions.explanation: The quality of being acidic; having a pH below 7.

⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酸性|さんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{酸性雨|さんせいう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{森林|しんりん}→森林：01441_shinrin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Acid rain is causing damage to forests.

notes:
{酸性|さんせい} describes the acidic property of a substance — having a pH below 7. Used in chemistry, agriculture, environmental science, and everyday contexts like food and skincare.

COMPOUNDS:
- {酸性雨|さんせいう}: acid rain
- {酸性|さんせい}⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧: acidic soil
- {酸性|さんせい}⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: acidic foods
- {弱酸性|じゃくさんせい}: mildly acidic (common in skincare products)

pH SCALE VOCABULARY:
- {酸性|さんせい}: acidic (pH < 7)
- ⟦{中性|ちゅうせい}→中性：18084_chuusei⟧: neutral (pH 7)
- アルカリ{性|せい}: alkaline/basic (pH > 7)

USAGE:
As a の-adjective: {酸性|さんせい}の⟦{溶液|ようえき}→溶液：15120_youeki⟧ (acidic solution). Also used directly before nouns in compounds: {酸性雨|さんせいう}. The term {弱酸性|じゃくさんせい} (mildly acidic) is widely known from skincare advertising.

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧ (approval, agreement).
